task_description: Build a high-quality League of Legends-style web game from scratch as a static React + TypeScript + Vite + Phaser 3 SPA, deployable to GitHub Pages under the /game-champs/ subpath. Includes a main menu, champion select with an original roster (passive + Q/W/E/R abilities), a Phaser arena battle vs. an AI bot with minions/turrets, a results screen, procedural audio and visual polish, and mandatory Korean + English i18n with a language toggle. Orchestrator handles git push/deploy.

verification.summary: Final (post-review-fix) state: npm run build succeeds and dist/index.html references assets under the /game-champs/ base path. npm run test -- --run passes 91/91 across 8 files. npx tsc --noEmit is clean. Test quality: pure combat.ts/ai.ts/targeting logic is exhaustively unit-tested (armor math, lethal/hp-clamp, single-source cooldown cadence, per-behavior ability resolution, turret-gated nexus targeting, AI self-sustain vs offensive gating, deterministic nearest tie-break) with assertions that would fail if reverted; audio.test.ts asserts volume clamping/subscriber counts/headless-safety. No binary audio assets required. No Dockerfile in project, so docker_build skipped.

review.notes: v1 raised 7 issues (turret double cooldown tick, nexus not turret-gated, AI defensive-ability gating, enemy enchanter non-threat, Korean default language, nearest-enemy tie-break, hp-regen ordering). Coder fixed 6 with new pure-logic unit tests (test count 69->91) and consciously deferred the low-impact hp-regen ordering. v2 confirmed all resolved with no regressions and APPROVED.
